agent_notes: The official MP Higher Education Department college profile confirms the Mandleshwar campus and District Khargone.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected official NIRF and highereducation.mp.gov.in hosts.

The official Regular Courses and Distance Education Courses pages expose current programme rows, but the official Prospectus and New Course Started pages are under construction; course catalogue status is therefore partial and the record remains manual_review.
No duration was published in the central catalogue, so duration fields remain null.

Certificate Courses entries without a session date were retained as official catalogue programme families with null eligibility and duration. The duplicate Fundamental Rights entry was deduplicated, and the explicitly historical Certificate in Self defence traning 2021-22 and 2022-23 entries were excluded as expired offerings.

Career mappings were checked against assets/data/career_path.db read-only. M.A. subject entries use nearest-parent BA discipline nodes where no exact M.A. node exists; generic certificates without a responsible node retain mapping_gap.
